data.long_meaning: The name Massimiliano is derived from the Latin words maxima (greatest) and magnus (great). It translates to 'more massive' or 'gracious'. The name was popular among early Christians and has been used throughout history. The name Massimiliano carries the meaning “More Massive, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Massimiliano usually hope their child will grow to embody more massive, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
